title: The Archer's Path
content:
Lena was walking through a forest when she found an old bow and arrow near a tree.

— What is this? — she asked.

She picked up the bow and looked at the arrows.

— These are very old.

Suddenly, she heard a voice behind her.

— Don't touch that!

Lena turned around. An old archer was standing near the trees.

— Why? — she asked.

— That bow belongs to the Guardian of the Forest.

The archer pointed to a mountain.

— Do you see those rocks?

— Yes.

— The Guardian lives behind them.

Lena looked at the bow.

— Can I take this with me?

The archer smiled.

— Yes. But use it carefully.

Lena picked up the bow and arrows.

— Then this is the beginning of my adventure!

She walked toward the mountains, ready to discover the secret of the forest.
